title: Writing --- My Own Line
label: ch:fa-my-own-line
canDo: I can write one line of Persian about myself from words I know, with no model to copy, and check every dot before anything else.

payoff.summary: Complete FA-W287-khat-e-khodam: one line chosen rather than copied, with the dots checked letter by letter.
payoff.note: The first writing step with nothing to reach for. Copying hid the dot decision: in Persian script a dot is part of the letter, so a moved or dropped dot writes a different letter, and final ye carries none.
